header.name: THESOV
header.sub: LEGACY IRON · 4× RTX 3090 · LOCAL LLM · AGENTS

stages.title: GPU FORGE
stages.zone: A Gigabyte MC62-G40 with four blower 3090s for inference. A fix for the BMC's fan spikes, and a fan floor in the VBIOS.

stages.title: LEGACY IRON
stages.zone: A Supermicro H11SSL-i with an EPYC, silenced from Windows without installing anything: raw IPMI over WMI, and SDR records deleted and restored.

stages.title: INFERENCE
stages.zone: The MC62 as an inference server, benchmarked with vLLM without P2P or NVLink, plus tools that let agents read huge PDFs without overflowing their context.

stages.title: AGENTS
stages.zone: Multi-agent systems: Kubernetes manifests from plain language, claims checked against Wikipedia, and real-time voice calls.

stages.title: ELECTRONICS
stages.zone: Sensors, shunts and firmware to measure and control the rest of the hardware.

stages.title: FABRICATOR
stages.zone: Functional 3D printing: ducts for the 3090s, brackets, enclosures for the electronics.

stages.title: TRAINING
stages.zone: Fine-tuning on the 3090s: LoRA, my own datasets, and evaluation.

stages.title: CROSSOVER
stages.zone: Where the stages already meet: firmware, BMCs and scripts that tame server hardware.

cleared.text: Quiet fans on an EPYC from Windows without installing tools: raw IPMI over WMI, and the low-RPM fail-safe traced in the SEL.
A fan floor in the VBIOS of the blower 3090s with Vix's loader, plus a fix for the BMC's fan spikes.
vLLM on four 3090s without P2P or NVLink: MoE models run 2 to 4 times faster than dense ones, and at 280 W per GPU they match 350 W.
Three CrewAI agents that turn requirements into Kubernetes manifests and validate them.

locked.text: Printed ducts so the blowers don't have to scream.
Measuring what the server draws per generated token.

demons.caption: Private repos. They have no name here. Some sleep, some pay the rent, one talks to the BMC at three in the morning.
